name: Roka
detail: A cooperative adventure rescuing tropical creatures from a volcanic jungle island. Friendly toucan, small tapir and lemur safely gathered aboard a little wooden rescue boat beside lush tropical leaves, a distant smoking volcano with glowing orange lava streams. Premium carved stone and layered leaf relief illustration, tactile shapes, volcanic orange and crimson contrasted with deep jungle green and warm pale stone. Dramatic but hopeful, readable bold animal silhouettes. Companion spine is carved tropical leaf and volcanic ember ornament.

name: Soma
detail: A storm-stranded airship being repaired while a secret saboteur hides aboard. Beautiful illustrated cutaway cross-section of a brass and teal airship: welcoming little mechanical workshops inside its hull, warm work lamps, intricate ropes, propellers, gears and rigging; sweeping stormclouds behind its great teal balloon. A few small friendly crew silhouettes work on repairs, one mysterious shadow at a doorway. Brass engraved mechanical illustration and richly painted teal enamel, warm amber light, mysterious yet cozy. Companion spine is brass mechanical rigging, gears and teal enamel ornament.
